selected_prototype: Reuse TPS386000RGPR and TLV76033DBZR types on an independent domain; wire-OR resets, same filtered VDD pulls READY up, external pull-down, no READY reservoir capacitor.

startup.qualification: Filtered ramp satisfies a slew comparison, not output-current guarantee during POR.

reference_counterexample.conclusion: No overlapping divider factor even with ideal resistors. A 2.445 V plateau can count as valid on some units. For combined supply brownout, verify 12 V UV disarms before REF exits the safe range and restarts the whole delay. Independent REF drift is not covered by this comparator threshold alone.
